content:
step on your heart

Every dream is a melody
How can I hear all these sweet memories
I want to show you them all,all I've kept inside
Let's sing now together
what's in our hearts

Accidental melody
Like a flower blooming,kiss your soul
The door that only you can see
Inside your heart it brings you on a journey
A time that's filled with inspiration
A rainbow paved a road into clouds
I see your fingers hover
and suddenly a melody is born

Make sure you don't miss a sign
Just draw and exclamation
and run right through the clouds
A dream is never really small
Hey,can you hear me now?
The whole world is listening!

In every dream there's a melody
Within your heart a secret to see
And if this pain is replaced by this melody
I will gladly sing forever

Countless memories like fireworks
They spread across the entire universe
The notes in our melody,shining in the sky
Stars for you!
Ahhhhh~
